hints: Walk the row and ask, at each house, what the best total ending here or before here is.
At house `i` there are two choices: take it, which means you could not have taken `i-1`, or skip it, which leaves whatever was best up to `i-1`.
So `best(i) = max(best(i-1), best(i-2) + houses[i])` - the same two-back shape as the stairs, with a maximum instead of a sum.
Only the last two values matter, so two variables replace the table.
